apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Apify synthetic event, charged automatically once per GB of run memory (1 GB minimum). Kept at Apify's default price.

url-checked.eventDescription: Charged once per URL that was HTTP-checked and recorded as a result row (including 3xx/4xx/5xx and network errors). Also charged when a checked URL is filtered out of the dataset — the check still ran. Invalid inputs that never become a checked row are not charged.
